about:
NY Custom Furnishings operates from Long Island City in the New York City borough of Queens. The company describes itself as a specialized design and construction firm focused on bespoke upholstered furniture. Public records do not disclose a founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The firm produces a range of custom furniture pieces including sofas, sectionals, chairs, chaises, beds, headboards, ottomans, tables, and banquettes. Its capabilities extend to carpentry, wood turning, and window treatments, suggesting an in-house workshop that handles both upholstery and solid-wood fabrication. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The company does not list specific industries or customer types on its website. Its portfolio of finished rooms and individual pieces indicates a focus on residential and contract interiors, serving designers, architects, and property owners who require made-to-order upholstery and case goods.

The firm has not published a statement about why it was founded or what differentiates it from other custom furniture makers.
